He walks clockwise around the Druid Ring in a circular path.
Spawns near the rings at -1680,-1310 next to a tree, turns SE stops at -2265,-2155, heads South turns at -2590,-2145 goes SW
stops at -3105,-1760 turns West, stops at -3235,-815 continues West, turns at -3270,-190 goes North, stops at -2525,-195 goes NE, returns to -1680,-1310 spawn point.
Takes 11 minutes to complete a cycle. 

A Griffon, A Scythe Beetle, a Grizzly Bear, and other mobs often path through this spot.
